components.name: Card
components.signature: Card(children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | Tabs | Carousel | Stack | Map | SVG)[], variant?: "card" | "sunk" | "clear", direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" | "baseline", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around" | "evenly", wrap?: boolean)
components.description: Styled container. variant: "card" (default, elevated) | "sunk" (recessed) | "clear" (transparent). Always full width. Accepts all Stack flex params (default: direction "column"). Cards flex to share space in row/wrap layouts.
components.purpose: 完整对象或独立内容单元
components.treatment: 共享横排空间；card／sunk／clear 各自边界规则固定；不裁掉内容边缘字形，不用它包装所有章节

components.name: CardHeader
components.signature: CardHeader(title?: string, subtitle?: string)
components.description: Header with optional title and subtitle
components.treatment: 标题走对象角色，subtitle 走辅助角色；两字段均可选，只有 subtitle 也能正常显示

components.name: TextContent
components.signature: TextContent(text: string, size?: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy")
components.description: Text block. Supports markdown. Optional size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy".
components.treatment: 支持 Markdown；大小和加重选项映射既有文字角色；可直接写文字，不强制每句话拆变量

components.name: MarkDownRenderer
components.signature: MarkDownRenderer(textMarkdown: string, variant?: "clear" | "card" | "sunk")
components.description: Renders markdown text with optional container variant
components.treatment: 标题层级走主题映射；链接下划线；card／sunk 外观按参数；不重复包章节 Card

components.name: Callout
components.signature: Callout(variant: "info" | "warning" | "error" | "success" | "neutral", title: string, description: string, visible?: $binding<boolean>)
components.description: Callout banner. Optional visible is a reactive $boolean — auto-dismisses after 3s by setting $visible to false.
components.treatment: 普通说明采用轻量竖线；成功／警告／错误保留小状态图标和语义；reactive visible 支持自动消退

components.name: TextCallout
components.signature: TextCallout(variant?: "neutral" | "info" | "warning" | "success" | "danger", title?: string, description?: string)
components.description: Text callout with variant, title, and description
components.treatment: 复用提示视觉，但不假装执行 Callout 的响应式消退；说明与真正状态区分

components.name: Image
components.signature: Image(alt: string, src?: string)
components.description: Image with alt text and optional URL
components.treatment: 媒体比例依据角色；父级分配宽度，中性缺图占位；点击预览，失败后点击原位重新加载，恢复局部动画，不显示 Retry 按钮

components.name: ImageBlock
components.signature: ImageBlock(src: string, alt?: string)
components.description: Image block with loading state
components.treatment: 按媒体比例与圆角显示一张图片，支持预览及原位点击重试；SDK 渲染库支持；当前客户端生成库明确排除，模型应以客户端实际 spec 为准

components.name: ImageGallery
components.signature: ImageGallery(images: {src: string, alt?: string, details?: string}[])
components.description: Gallery grid of images with modal preview
components.treatment: 根据实际可用宽度、间距和现有紧凑阅读宽度分列，不在窄容器硬塞三列；已知集合形状先分配宽度，内联预览最多按五个可见槽分列，下载只替换画面；支持原图预览与缩放、原位重试和刷新保留内容

components.name: CodeBlock
components.signature: CodeBlock(language: string, codeString: string)
components.description: Syntax-highlighted code block
components.treatment: 等宽字体、语言标识、横向阅读长行、原生复制反馈；代码不当作 Agent 已执行结果

components.name: InlineHeader
components.signature: InlineHeader(heading: string, description?: string)
components.description: Compact section heading with an optional one-line description, for use inside cards.
components.treatment: 与对象标题共用标题映射，description 使用辅助样式；不为名称另造字号

components.name: Table
components.signature: Table(columns: Col[])
components.description: Data table — column-oriented. Each Col holds its own data array.
components.treatment: 管列宽、表头、单元格及横向视口；宽表允许横向阅读，不靠缩小所有文字强塞

components.name: Col
components.signature: Col(label: string, data: any, type?: "string" | "number" | "action")
components.description: Column definition — holds label + data array
components.treatment: 定义列名称、数据及类型，由 Table 消费；不独立显示、不额外包容器

components.name: EditableTable
components.signature: EditableTable(name?: string, columns?: {type: "text" | "number" | "date-single" | "select" | "url", key?: string, header?: string, width?: number, options?: {value: string, label: string}[]}[], data?: {id: string, values: (string | number)[]}[])
components.description: Spreadsheet-like table whose cells the user can edit inline (text, number, url, date, select columns); edits are saved back as a form field
components.treatment: 原生编辑和状态写回；表格边界消费外部 stretch，避免泄漏到单元格按钮

components.name: BarChart
components.signature: BarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
components.description: Vertical bars; use for comparing values across categories with one or more series
components.treatment: 分类完整后，已确认数值形成柱；缺数据不补零，轴与图例为数据留阅读空间

components.name: LineChart
components.signature: LineChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "linear" | "natural" | "step", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
components.description: Lines over categories; use for trends and continuous data over time
components.treatment: 分类完整后，完整数据点逐步形成线；不把未完成的尾数字当成真实点

components.name: AreaChart
components.signature: AreaChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "linear" | "natural" | "step", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
components.description: Filled area under lines; use for cumulative totals or volume trends over time
components.treatment: 复用笛卡尔数据／坐标规则，面积只代表已确认的数据

components.name: RadarChart
components.signature: RadarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[])
components.description: Spider/web chart; use for comparing multiple variables across one or more entities
components.treatment: 分类与系列完整后呈现；分类标签有独立测量空间；类别轴与数值含义对应，不用缩字掩盖密集标签

components.name: HorizontalBarChart
components.signature: HorizontalBarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
components.description: Horizontal bars; prefer when category labels are long or for ranked lists
components.purpose: 长分类名称的数量比较
components.treatment: 使用横向柱形和对应分类轴；遵守相同数据与图例规则

components.name: Series
components.signature: Series(category: string, values: number[])
components.description: One data series
components.treatment: 由图表消费名称、值和对应信息；不单独显示

components.name: PieChart
components.signature: PieChart(labels: string[], values: number[], variant?: "pie" | "donut", appearance?: "circular" | "semiCircular")
components.description: Circular slices; use plucked arrays: PieChart(data.categories, data.values)
components.treatment: 依赖可确认的完整总量再表达占比，避免把暂时总量当最终比例

components.name: RadialChart
components.signature: RadialChart(labels: string[], values: number[])
components.description: Radial bars; use plucked arrays: RadialChart(data.categories, data.values)
components.treatment: 同样等待比例所需数据；首次等待不画假圆环充当结果

components.name: SingleStackedBarChart
components.signature: SingleStackedBarChart(labels: string[], values: number[])
components.description: Single horizontal stacked bar; use plucked arrays: SingleStackedBarChart(data.categories, data.values)
components.treatment: 使用较低的原生图形高度；图例可换行，数值与整体条件一致

components.name: Slice
components.signature: Slice(category: string, value: number)
components.description: One slice with label and numeric value
components.treatment: 不独立渲染；当前 PieChart 接口仍接收 labels／values 数组，不能因有 Slice 定义就替换输入类型

components.name: ScatterChart
components.signature: ScatterChart(datasets: ScatterSeries[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
components.description: X/Y scatter plot; use for correlations, distributions, and clustering
components.treatment: 成对、可确认的坐标组成点；按散点投影与邻近点检查，不混用分类索引

components.name: ScatterSeries
components.signature: ScatterSeries(name: string, points: Point[])
components.description: Named dataset
components.treatment: 提供一组 Point，由 ScatterChart 解释

components.name: Point
components.signature: Point(x: number, y: number, z?: number)
components.description: Data point with numeric coordinates
components.treatment: 保留 x／y 成对含义；不独立生成图形视图

components.name: Form
components.signature: Form(name: string, buttons: Buttons, fields?: FormControl[])
components.description: Form container with fields and explicit action buttons
components.treatment: 默认 Card 任务面板；维护精确表单作用域、校验及字段值；宿主可显式取消表面；不把纯展示或单个跳转包装成 Form

components.name: FormControl
components.signature: FormControl(label: string, input: Input | TextArea | Select | DatePicker | Slider | CheckBoxGroup | RadioGroup | Chips | OptionCards, hint?: string)
components.description: Field with label, input component, and optional hint text
components.treatment: 将 label、input、hint 关联；复合控件可通过渲染注册信息承接标题，避免再插一行标签；普通输入保留外部标题；错误与字段就近显示

components.name: Label
components.signature: Label(text: string)
components.description: Text label
components.treatment: 使用既有正文尺度；它本身不建立输入绑定或校验关系

components.name: Input
components.signature: Input(name: string, placeholder?: string, type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "url", rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>)
components.treatment: 原生文本输入、相应类型与校验；按字段状态绑定，避免源码更新覆盖用户输入

components.name: TextArea
components.signature: TextArea(name: string, placeholder?: string, rows?: number, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>)
components.treatment: 保留多行编辑、选择和光标；内容可自然增长，字段身份不随重排重建

components.name: Select
components.signature: Select(name: string, items: SelectItem[], placeholder?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>, size?: "small" | "medium" | "large")
components.treatment: 菜单／原生选择呈现；值由对应 SelectItem 提供；显示值与实际 value 对应

components.name: SelectItem
components.signature: SelectItem(value: string, label: string)
components.description: Option for Select
components.treatment: 由 Select 消费标签、值、禁用状态；不独立创建第二个控件

components.name: DatePicker
components.signature: DatePicker(name: string, mode?: "single" | "range", rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<any>)
components.treatment: 原生日期呈现，遵循已注册契约和最近 locale；不把未到达日期补成一个业务结果

components.name: Slider
components.signature: Slider(name: string, variant: "continuous" | "discrete", min: number, max: number, step?: number, defaultValue?: number[], label?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<number[]>)
components.description: Numeric slider input; supports continuous and discrete (stepped) variants
components.treatment: 标题与当前值同排，下方轨道及辅助说明；不重复叠放数值灰框。连续值保留精确编辑，离散值保留选择器；iOS 不铺满刻度圆点，取值和步长语义不变

components.name: CheckBoxGroup
components.signature: CheckBoxGroup(name: string, items: CheckBoxItem[], rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<Record<string, boolean>>)
components.treatment: 单值变化写入共享字段状态；是否统一提交由外部任务决定，不必总有 Form

components.name: CheckBoxItem
components.signature: CheckBoxItem(label: string, description: string, name: string, defaultChecked?: boolean)
components.treatment: 由 Group 读取 value、标签、描述及禁用状态

components.name: RadioGroup
components.signature: RadioGroup(name: string, items: RadioItem[], defaultValue?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>)
components.treatment: 统一选择存储和禁用行为；控制是否可提交由表单校验处理

components.name: RadioItem
components.signature: RadioItem(label: string, description: string, value: string)
components.treatment: 由 RadioGroup 消费，不自行维护另一份选择

components.name: SwitchGroup
components.signature: SwitchGroup(name: string, items: SwitchItem[], variant?: "clear" | "card" | "sunk", value?: $binding<Record<string, boolean>>)
components.description: Group of switch toggles
components.treatment: 使用原生开关表达开启／关闭，状态写回同一字段体系

components.name: SwitchItem
components.signature: SwitchItem(label: string, description: string, name: string, defaultChecked?: boolean)
components.description: Individual switch toggle
components.treatment: 提供值、标签及说明，由 Group 维护状态

components.name: ChipItem
components.signature: ChipItem(value: string, label: string, icon?: Icon, disabled?: boolean)
components.description: A single selectable chip inside a Chips group, with a value, label and optional icon.
components.treatment: 提供键、标签、图标及禁用信息，由 Chips 消费

components.name: Chips
components.signature: Chips(name: string, type?: "single" | "multiple", items?: ChipItem[], rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, defaultValue?: string | string[])
components.description: A form field of compact selectable chips for choosing one or many short options; the selection is stored under `name`.
components.treatment: 支持契约内的单选／多选，自动换行；它是可操作控件，与静态 Tag 区分

components.name: OptionCard
components.signature: OptionCard(value: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, topContent?: Icon | Image, disabled?: boolean)
components.description: A single selectable card inside an OptionCards group, with a value, title, optional subtitle and an optional Icon or Image on top.
components.treatment: 真实控件只挂载一份；呈现图片／图标、标题、说明和选中状态，按 value 更新选择

components.name: OptionCards
components.signature: OptionCards(name: string, type?: "single" | "multiple", items?: OptionCard[], rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, defaultValue?: string | string[])
components.description: A form field of selectable cards (title, optional subtitle, optional icon or image) laid out in a responsive grid for choosing one or many options; the selection is stored under `name`.
components.treatment: 列数由可用宽度与既有最小列宽确定；长文案只增加行高；更窄空间和辅助功能大字号可单列

components.name: Button
components.signature: Button(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary", type?: "normal" | "destructive", size?: "extra-small" | "small" | "medium" | "large")
components.description: Clickable button
components.treatment: 根据 label 和已确认外观显示；pending、performing、disabled 分开；小按钮不被同行的触控高度撑大

components.name: Buttons
components.signature: Buttons(buttons: Button[], direction?: "row" | "column")
components.description: Group of Button components. direction: "row" (default) | "column".
components.treatment: row 自然宽度并逐项换行；column 铺满宽度；保持同一批控件身份，外层目标可同行对齐

components.name: IconButton
components.signature: IconButton(name: string, icon: Icon, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary", size?: "extra-small" | "small" | "medium" | "large", shape?: "square" | "circle")
components.description: Icon-only button. name is the accessible label and the action label; icon is an Icon; action fires on click.
components.treatment: 明确可访问名称、原生目标范围；方形／圆形遵循参数，不用图标猜测业务行为

components.name: Stack
components.signature: Stack(children: any[], direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" | "baseline", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around" | "evenly", wrap?: boolean)
components.description: Flex container. direction: "row"|"column" (default "column"). gap: "none"|"xs"|"s"|"m"|"l"|"xl"|"2xl" (default "m"). align: "start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"|"baseline". justify: "start"|"center"|"end"|"between"|"around"|"evenly".
components.treatment: 管 direction、gap、align、justify、wrap；保留普通内容宽度，不隐式等宽；等待布局参数时保留安全前缀

components.name: Tabs
components.signature: Tabs(items: TabItem[])
components.description: Tabbed container
components.treatment: 用户未操作时可跟随最后增长的面板；用户选择后尊重选择；宽标签横向阅读并提示溢出

components.name: TabItem
components.signature: TabItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | Map | SVG)[])
components.description: value is unique id, trigger is tab label, content is array of components
components.treatment: value 是稳定身份，trigger 是标签，content 是内容；不按显示文案重新识别

components.name: Accordion
components.signature: Accordion(items: AccordionItem[])
components.description: Collapsible sections
components.treatment: 原生折叠，当前实现维护一个展开项；分隔记录边界，长标签可换行

components.name: AccordionItem
components.signature: AccordionItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | Map | SVG)[])
components.description: value is unique id, trigger is section title
components.treatment: 提供稳定 value、标题和内容，由 Accordion 呈现

components.name: Steps
components.signature: Steps(items: StepsItem[])
components.description: Step-by-step guide
components.treatment: 序号、标题、详情和连线形成顺序；标记随文字尺度增长，不裁切数字

components.name: StepsItem
components.signature: StepsItem(title: string, details: string)
components.description: title and details text for one step
components.treatment: 由 Steps 消费；不能用它假装已经执行了业务步骤

components.name: Carousel
components.signature: Carousel(children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock)[][], variant?: "card" | "sunk")
components.description: Horizontal scrollable carousel
components.treatment: 外层数组是一组页面，内层数组是单页内容；不把页面数组拍平；遵守合法 children 类型，不能塞任意 Card／Stack

components.name: Separator
components.signature: Separator(orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical", decorative?: boolean)
components.description: Visual divider between content sections
components.treatment: 复用边界色；横线不作为每个标题的装饰；交通连接线与章节分隔按用途区分

components.name: TagBlock
components.signature: TagBlock(tags: string[], size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg")
components.description: tags is an array of strings; optional size sm | md | lg
components.treatment: 自动横向排列与换行；不重复标题和价格已有信息；不将完整前提或长段解释塞进标签

components.name: Tag
components.signature: Tag(text: string, icon?: Icon, size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg", variant?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger")
components.description: Styled tag/badge with optional Icon and variant
components.treatment: 普通属性中性胶囊；状态色需有依据；照片上使用稳定对比覆盖层，缺图时保持可读

components.name: Icon
components.signature: Icon(name: string, category?: string)
components.description: A lucide icon by kebab-case name (e.g. 'circle-check'). Optional category picks a topical fallback when the name doesn't resolve.
components.treatment: 使用固定 Lucide 目录及分类映射；图形名称不自动决定成功／警告等业务颜色

components.name: EntityList
components.signature: EntityList(rows?: {left: string, right: string, rightVariant?: "text" | "number"}[], size?: "small" | "default", header?: {left: string, right: string, rightVariant?: "text" | "number"}, footer?: {left: string, right: string, rightVariant?: "text" | "number"})
components.description: Two-column key/value rows (left label, right value). size 'default' supports optional header and footer rows; rightVariant 'number' uses tabular numbers.
components.treatment: 稳定左右等宽列，各自换行；名称辅助色、文字值中等强调、数值右对齐；记录间轻线，末行无线；不因长值整行改排

components.name: ListBlock
components.signature: ListBlock(items: ListItem[], variant?: "number" | "image", size?: "default" | "small")
components.description: A list of items with number or image indicators. Each item can optionally have an action. size small renders a compact list.
components.treatment: 父级组织 ListItem，密度和文字层级共享；不额外制造每项一张大卡

components.name: ListItem
components.signature: ListItem(title: string, subtitle?: string, image?: {src: string, alt: string}, actionLabel?: string, action?: ActionExpression)
components.description: Item in a ListBlock — displays a title with an optional subtitle and image. When action is provided, the item becomes clickable.
components.treatment: 展示标题、说明及合法操作；操作与对应条目绑定，不扩大为整页点击

components.name: Text
components.signature: Text(variant: "text" | "number", value: string, subtext?: string, subtextVariant?: "text" | "number" | "metric", size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg")
components.description: Plain text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red.
components.treatment: 按 size／variant 解析；value 与 subtext 分工；普通数字不随正文统一放大

components.name: BoldText
components.signature: BoldText(variant: "text" | "number", value: string, subtext?: string, subtextVariant?: "text" | "number" | "metric", size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg")
components.description: Emphasized (bold) text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red.
components.treatment: 复用 Text 路径并强调字重；subtext 仍是辅助角色；不靠把整段正文加粗制造重点

components.name: IconText
components.signature: IconText(icon: Icon, iconVariant: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "inverted" | "filled" | "soft", iconSize: "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean, layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical")
components.description: An icon badge with a title and optional subtitle, laid out horizontally or vertically. iconVariant sets the badge color.
components.treatment: 图标与整组标题／说明垂直居中；默认 m 为 20pt，l 为 24pt、xl 为 28pt，xs／s 保持紧凑；普通样式中性、无彩色圆底，显式状态保留语义色

components.name: ImageText
components.signature: ImageText(src: string, alt: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean, layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical", imageSize?: number)
components.description: A small square image (thumbnail/avatar) with a title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.
components.treatment: 横排图片与整组文字居中；无指定尺寸时按可用阅读空间调整缩略图，显式 imageSize 保持原意

components.name: ImageTextLarge
components.signature: ImageTextLarge(src: string, alt: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean)
components.description: A full-width banner image above a bold title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.
components.treatment: 默认 16:9 媒体框与覆盖裁切；名称与说明走统一角色，卡内可与外层边界协调出图。不会因来源图片是方图或海报而改成完整适配

components.name: MetricIndicatorInline
components.signature: MetricIndicatorInline(value: string, subtext?: string, trend?: {direction: "up" | "down", value: number})
components.description: Headline metric value with an optional +/- percentage trend and subtext, all on one line.
components.treatment: 能并排时按基线组织，空间不足可将说明下排；数值本体保持完整

components.name: MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough
components.signature: MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough(value: string, subtext?: string, previousValue?: string, trend?: {direction: "up" | "down", value: number})
components.description: Headline metric value with an optional struck-through previousValue, a +/- percentage trend, and subtext below.
components.treatment: 当前值突出，旧值删除线，趋势与说明次级；不把涨跌天然解释成业务好坏

components.name: SnippetCardItem
components.signature: SnippetCardItem(id: string, lhs: IconText | ImageText, rhs?: Text | BoldText)
components.description: One row-style snippet card: a label on the left (IconText or ImageText) and an optional value on the right (Text or BoldText).
components.treatment: 名称、图标或缩略图、简短说明形成摘要；lhs／rhs 的文字值保持左右关系，长地址在右列内部换行；数字／指标保留完整数值所需宽度，空间不足时允许下排；内容与操作属于同一对象

components.name: SnippetCardBlock
components.signature: SnippetCardBlock(items: SnippetCardItem[], layout?: "grid", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
components.description: A responsive grid of compact label/value cards (2 per row) for showing several short facts side by side; optionally clickable with a shared action.
components.treatment: 仅支持 grid；responsive 默认启用，以对象最小阅读宽度分列、最多两列；复用集合几何与逐项就绪策略

components.name: OverviewCardItem
components.signature: OverviewCardItem(id: string, top: IconText | ImageText | Text, bottom?: MetricIndicatorInline)
components.description: One overview card: a heading slot at the top (IconText, ImageText or Text) and an optional MetricIndicatorInline at the bottom.
components.treatment: 主要信息与底部指标分层；同一网格行的指标起点对齐，说明长短不把数值挤到不同高度

components.name: OverviewCardBlock
components.signature: OverviewCardBlock(items: OverviewCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
components.description: A grid or horizontal carousel of compact overview cards, each with a heading (icon/image/text) on top and an inline metric below; optionally clickable with a shared action.
components.treatment: 组织可比较条目；维持行内对齐与可用宽度，不依赖选中页决定集合高度

components.name: ContextCardItem
components.signature: ContextCardItem(id: string, title: string | Tag, body?: string, bgColor?: "gray", bgImageSrc?: string, bgImageAlt?: string)
components.description: A single card inside a ContextCardBlock: a title (plain string or Tag), an optional markdown body, and an optional gray tint or background image.
components.treatment: 可有背景图；文字与图片覆盖层保持对比，缺图时转为中性可读内容

components.name: ContextCardBlock
components.signature: ContextCardBlock(items: ContextCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
components.description: A grid or carousel of compact tinted context cards (title or tag plus a short bold body); an optional action makes every card clickable.
components.treatment: 按布局参数呈现；不将整组图片下载完成作为文字展示门槛

components.name: CompositeCardItem
components.signature: CompositeCardItem(id?: string, header?: IconText | ImageText | ImageTextLarge | Text | Image, body?: (Text | BoldText | MetricIndicatorInline | IconText | Image | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | ListBlock | TagBlock | EntityList)[], footer?: {price?: BoldText | MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough, button?: Button})
components.description: A single card inside a CompositeCardBlock: an optional header (icon/image/text), a stack of body elements (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags), and an optional price/button footer.
components.purpose: 商品、酒店、票务等完整对象
components.treatment: 与通用内容 Card 共用面板留白；图片头内收，body 放短介绍／属性；footer 与通用 row／between／wrap 共用布局，空间不足时价格与操作下排，保留同一操作实例

components.name: CompositeCardBlock
components.signature: CompositeCardBlock(items: CompositeCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
components.description: A two-per-row grid or carousel of rich cards, each with an optional header, stacked body content (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags) and a price/button footer; an optional action makes every card clickable.
components.treatment: 支持网格／横滑；已知集合数稳定先到条目的宽度，单卡可先于整组出现

components.name: VisualCardItem
components.signature: VisualCardItem(body: BoldText, id?: string, bgImageSrc?: string, tag?: Tag, bgImageAlt?: string)
components.description: A single photo-first card inside a VisualCardBlock: a BoldText body panel, an optional Tag, and a background image (bgImageSrc must be a real URL; bgImageAlt is its alt text).
components.treatment: 标题、短描述和 Tag 叠图；渐变与深色半透明胶囊保证可读；缺图不变成黑色大块

components.name: VisualCardBlock
components.signature: VisualCardBlock(items: VisualCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
components.description: A grid or carousel of photo-first cards: a full-bleed background image with a tag on top and a bold text panel at the bottom; an optional action makes every card clickable.
components.treatment: 图形结构与下载分开；照片可预览，已有整卡动作时通过长按菜单预览，单击仍执行卡片动作；横滑只处理水平意图

components.name: Modal
components.signature: Modal(title: string, open: $binding<boolean>, children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock)[], size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg")
components.description: Modal dialog. open is a reactive $boolean binding — set to true to open, X/Escape/backdrop auto-closes. Put Form with buttons inside children.
components.treatment: 原生 sheet，open 可绑定共享状态，关闭写回当前呈现；内容与尺寸按面板空间组织

components.name: FollowUpBlock
components.signature: FollowUpBlock(items: FollowUpItem[])
components.description: List of clickable follow-up suggestions placed at the end of a response
components.treatment: 作为回复末尾的后续入口组织；保持可读与可点击范围，不当作正文标签

components.name: FollowUpItem
components.signature: FollowUpItem(text: string)
components.description: Clickable follow-up suggestion — when clicked, sends text as user message
components.treatment: 点击产生继续对话事件；宿主决定如何进入实际 Agent 链路

components.name: Map
components.signature: Map(points: (MapPoint)[], crs?: "wgs84" | "gcj02")
components.description: Use when spatial relationships help the user understand content, compare locations, or plan a route. Place data and coordinates must come from reliable sources.
components.purpose: 地点位置、标记和关联对象浏览
components.treatment: SDK 使用 MapKit，支持标记、地点卡联动与全屏；仅选中地点显示地图标题，避免邻近地名叠在一起；地图要求 iOS 17／macOS 14，旧系统明确提示；地点图不等于已取得导航路线或实时交通

components.name: MapPoint
components.signature: MapPoint(title: string, lat: number, lng: number, imageSrc?: string, url?: string, description?: string)
components.description: A geographically locatable place. A name, latitude, and longitude are required.
components.treatment: 提供名称、坐标、图片及说明，由 Map 消费；坐标系必须匹配

components.name: SVG
components.signature: SVG(content?: string, src?: string, alt?: string, height?: number)
components.description: Use to explain shapes, structures, mechanisms, or relationships when a diagram makes them easier to understand. Keep the key idea clear and labels readable at the available width. Supply either inline SVG content or an HTTPS src, not both, with a valid viewBox. Size is derived automatically from viewBox; omit height.
components.treatment: SDK 在隔离 WKWebView 中渲染；inline content 与 HTTPS src 二选一，必须有正数 viewBox；禁用脚本、外部引用与交互导航，内容上限 1MB

examples.source:
root = Stack([intro, overview, temperature, mechanism, modes, efficiency, conclusion, followUps], "column", "l")
intro = Stack([intro_part1, intro_part2], "column", "xs")
intro_part1 = TextContent("空调冬天能制热，其实是因为它有一种很巧妙的能力：**把室外的热量搬到室内，而不是直接制造热量。**")
intro_part2 = TextContent("它的原理叫作 **热泵（Heat Pump）**，你可以把它理解成一台能够反向工作的冰箱。")
overview = Stack([overviewTitle, overviewCards], "column", "s")
overviewTitle = Stack([overviewTitle_part1, overviewTitle_part2], "column", "xs")
overviewTitle_part1 = MarkDownRenderer("### 核心概览")
overviewTitle_part2 = TextContent("两件事就能理解空调制热", "small")
overviewCards = OverviewCardBlock([overviewSource, overviewDirection], "grid")
overviewSource = OverviewCardItem("heat-source", IconText(Icon("wind"), "info", "s", "热量从哪里来"), MetricIndicatorInline("室外空气", "低温空气中仍然有热量"))
overviewDirection = OverviewCardItem("heat-direction", IconText(Icon("arrow-right"), "warning", "s", "热量往哪里去"), MetricIndicatorInline("室外 → 室内", "压缩机驱动热量搬运"))
temperature = Stack([temperature_part1, temperature_part2, temperature_part3, temperatureCard, temperature_part5], "column", "s")
temperature_part1 = MarkDownRenderer("### 01 · 冬天室外那么冷，哪来的热量？")
temperature_part2 = TextContent("这是最容易困惑的地方。**温度低不代表没有热量。** 即使室外只有 0℃，空气中的分子仍然在运动，仍然具有热能。")
temperature_part3 = TextContent("只要空调内部的制冷剂温度比室外空气更低，就能从室外吸收热量。")
temperatureCard = Card([temperatureCard_part1, temperatureCard_part2], "sunk", "column", "xs")
temperatureCard_part1 = EntityList([{"left":"室外空气","right":"0℃"},{"left":"制冷剂","right":"-15℃"}], "small")
temperatureCard_part2 = TextContent("热量就能从 0℃ 的空气流向 -15℃ 的制冷剂。上述温度仅为原理示例，不是空调运行时的固定值。")
temperature_part5 = TextContent("然后，空调通过压缩机把制冷剂变成高温高压状态，再把热量释放到室内。")
